name: Daisy Chain
source:
Patricia's art project has been wrecked the day before the school's art festival, and she desperately wants to know who's responsible... good thing junior detectives Darcy Daisy and Lester Leaves are on the case!

[From [url=https://tesspieceface.itch.io/daisy-chain]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
帕特里夏的艺术项目在学校艺术节的前一天被破坏了，她迫切地想知道谁该对此负责……幸好初级侦探达西·黛西和莱斯特·利夫斯正在处理此案！

[来自[url=https://tesspieceface.itch.io/daisy-chain]itch.io[/url]]
